senses.gloss:
आटोपः [आ-तुप्-घञ् पृषो˚ टत्वम् Tv.]
—1 Pride, self-conceit, arrogance; साटोपम् proudly, in a stately or
 majestic manner, frequently used as a stage-direction.
—2 Swelling, spreading, expanding, puffing; Prov. फटाटोपो भयंकरः;
 said also of clouds, अद्यापि साटोपा मेघा दृश्यन्ते Pt. 1; Śi. 3. 74.
—3 Flatulence (in the belly).
